items.title: Ticket resale
items.text: Ticket resale, known in North American English as ticket scalping and in British English as ticket touting when done for profit, is the act of reselling tickets for admission to events. Tickets are bought from licensed sellers and then sold for a price determined by the individual or company in possession of the tickets. Tickets sold through secondary sources may be sold for less or more than their face value depending on demand, which tends to vary as the event date approaches. items.title: Sneaker collecting
items.text: Sneaker collecting is the acquisition and trading of sneakers as a hobby. It is often manifested by the use and collection of shoes made for particular sports, particularly basketball and skateboarding. A person involved in sneaker collecting is sometimes called a sneakerhead.

items.title: Grey market
items.text: A grey market or dark market is the trade of a commodity through distribution channels that are not authorised by the original manufacturer or trademark proprietor. Grey market products are products traded outside the manufacturer's authorised channel.
